issues.element: Header action cluster (refresh / globe / sign-out) top right: a ~50px-tall bordered box whose right edge overhangs the content column by ~27px at 1440 (box ends x~1415, toolbar/cards end x~1388) and ~32px at 1920x950 and 2293; it is also visually heavier than the H1 beside it
issues.fix: Right-align the cluster to the same edge as the toolbar panel and cards, and drop the outer border (or shrink to 32px icon buttons matching toolbar control height) so the title row reads as one grid line

issues.element: KPI row forced to 8 across (~185px cards): 'p95 execution duration · ms' and 'Reported output tokens' wrap to two lines, pushing those labels above the icon centre, and every sparkline drops below its value, making the row 130px tall with ragged label baselines
issues.fix: Switch the KPI grid to 4x2 below ~2000px content width (as at 1440), or keep 8 across only when each card is >=240px; never let labels wrap inside a single row

issues.element: KPI row 1: Estimated cost card puts its sparkline on a new line under $1,547.35 while the other three cards keep it inline; the row stretches to 120px and Retained events/Failed events get a ~35px empty band above their subtitles; 'p95 execution duration · ms' and 'Reported output tokens' wrap
issues.fix: Use one card internal layout per breakpoint: at this width stack value-above-sparkline in every card (or go to 2 columns), so values, sparklines and subtitles share baselines across the row

issues.element: KPI sparklines start at different x-positions: the Failed events red line starts flush with the card text edge while all other sparklines are indented ~36px
issues.fix: Give every sparkline the same left inset (flush with the label/value text edge) and the same width

issues.element: Tab grid 'Tokens & Cache' wraps to two lines and KPI labels 'Retained events' / 'p95 execution duration · ms' wrap to 2–3 lines in the 2-column KPI grid
issues.fix: Below ~360px use a single-column KPI grid and a 2-column tab grid (or horizontally scrollable segmented tabs)

issues.element: Apply button beside the search field now renders grey-on-grey (same tone as a disabled control); in r14 it was a light fill
issues.fix: If Apply is enabled, give it the standard secondary-button surface (lifted grey with white text like Refresh); if disabled until text is typed, keep the muted style but make the enabled state visibly different

issues.element: Selected segment in tabs / time range / bucket groups (Overview, Last 24 hours, Auto) is now only a slightly lifted grey fill with the same regular weight as unselected items; at 3440 the difference is about one grey step
issues.fix: Keep the no-width-shift approach but add a second cue: brighter text (white vs grey for unselected) plus a 1px lighter border on the selected segment, or use font-weight 600 with reserved width

issues.element: Cost explanation notice is an ~80px padded card with two short lines and a large empty right side, while Tokens and Performance use a ~37px single-line notice strip with 'Measurement details' disclosure
issues.fix: Render the cost note as the same one-line notice strip ('Estimated API-equivalent cost at configured rates…  ▸ Measurement details') and move 'Legacy cache-write lifetime unavailable' into the disclosure

issues.element: KPI cards are 3 wide (~640px each): the cost value sits at the left and the sparkline floats ~250px away at the right edge; Priced/Unpriced flat sparklines read as divider rules
issues.fix: Cap sparkline gap by giving the value+sparkline a fixed max width (e.g. sparkline 180px right after the value), or fill the row with additional KPIs; hide or label flat sparklines (e.g. 'steady') so they don't look like rules

issues.element: p95 reported TTFT chart stacks full width under the duration chart with a 0–400 axis while data lives at 200–320, leaving the lower half of a 220px plot empty; at 2293 the two charts sit side-by-side
issues.fix: Place the two charts side-by-side from ~1280px (as at 2293), or shorten the TTFT plot / fit its y-domain to the data

issues.element: Uncached input tokens card: 'No range total' is pinned to the card bottom with a ~40px gap below 'Unavailable' (r14 sat directly under it)
issues.fix: Keep the subtitle directly under the value on stacked mobile cards; only bottom-align subtitles when every card in the row has one

issues.element: Three stacked notes before the table: grey 'Reference: …' card, amber 'Model catalog unavailable…' banner, and the 'USD per million tokens…' caption
issues.fix: Merge the reference sentence into the table caption line and keep only the amber banner as a separate block

issues.element: Time range, bucket and outcome controls stay fully active on Model Rates although the copy says these are current configured rates, not historical
issues.fix: Dim/disable the time-range and bucket groups on this tab (with a tooltip 'Rates are current, not time-ranged') so the controls only look interactive where they apply

issues.element: Card header: 'Requests' title and '128 retained events' count sit on different baselines (count ~6px lower); at 1440 'Usage presence reported' wraps to two lines in the Input/output column
issues.fix: Align the header row items on one baseline (align-items: baseline); shorten the sub-label to 'Usage reported' or let that column take the width freed from the Details column

issues.element: Skeleton KPI cards are ~102px tall and the chart skeleton starts ~355px from top, while loaded cards are ~132px and the chart starts ~382px: content jumps ~30px when data arrives (at 1440 they match)
issues.fix: Size the skeleton cards and chart block from the same layout tokens as the loaded state at every breakpoint; add placeholder bars for label/value/sparkline inside skeleton cards

issues.element: Retry is the only white-filled button on the page and duplicates the toolbar Refresh and header refresh icon
issues.fix: Use the same secondary button style as Refresh for Retry (or make Retry the only refresh affordance while in error by hiding the toolbar Refresh)

issues.element: Empty notice 'Choose a longer range to look further back' has no action; the 8 zero KPI cards below repeat the emptiness
issues.fix: Add an inline 'Show last 7 days' button in the empty notice; consider collapsing the zero KPI grid to a single compact row

issues.element: 'Current bucket: hour' disappears and Clear filters / Refresh collapse to bare × and ↻ icons, so the × reads as 'close panel' rather than 'clear filters'
issues.fix: Keep a short text label ('Clear') at this width, or move Clear/Refresh onto the search row's right end where there is space

regressions: All screens: selected segments in tabs, time range and bucket groups dropped bold weight; the selected state now relies on a faint grey lift and is weaker than r14, most visibly at 2293 and 3440.
Overview/Tokens/Cost/Performance: Apply button changed from a light fill to muted grey and now reads as disabled.
Tokens 390: 'No range total' under 'Unavailable' moved to the card bottom, leaving a ~40px gap that r14 did not have.
reference_gaps: Filters use native <select> controls with browser chevrons and square-ish styling; the reference uses custom dropdown triggers whose radius, padding and chevron match the segmented pills.
The reference segmented groups have hairline dividers between every option; Prox time-range and bucket groups show only the selected outline, so unselected options read as loose text.

The reference keeps one refresh control at the toolbar's right with a status pill ('(6s)'); Prox has a toolbar Refresh plus a second refresh icon in the bordered header cluster, and the 'Current bucket: hour' text label floats unboxed and disappears at <=1366.
The reference gives search its own full-width row with instant filtering; Prox shares the row with an Apply button and three dropdowns, which shrinks search to ~35% width at 1440.
The reference time-range group includes 'Custom'; Prox has no custom range entry.
